The site brings together rankings of gambling platforms, skin marketplaces and trading sites, instant-sell services, bonus and task sites, as well as Steam services. Instead of placing everything in one general list, we separate platforms by purpose so you can go straight to the relevant category and compare sites using the criteria that matter for that specific task.

A separate part of CSGOBROKER is dedicated to the Counter-Strike 2 ecosystem: skins, stickers, collections, cases, tournament items, professional player inventories and other data. This means the site can be used not only to compare third-party platforms, but also to navigate CS2 items and related sections.

chooser.title: How to Choose the Right Type of Site
chooser.intro: Before comparing individual platforms, it helps to define what you actually want to do. The same service may support several functions, but buying, selling, trading and game modes can have very different conditions. Here is a quick guide to the main scenarios.

items.summary: I Want to Buy a Specific CS2 Skin
items.body: For buying a specific skin, a marketplace is usually the most convenient option because you can search by item name, condition, price and other characteristics. When comparing platforms, consider the final price after fees, deposit methods, delivery speed and the transaction model. Start with the marketplaces and sites for buying skins sections.

items.summary: I Want to Sell a Skin and Withdraw Money
items.body: It is important to distinguish between a regular marketplace sale and instant selling. On a marketplace, the user usually sets a price and waits for a buyer. An instant-sell service buys the item faster, but the offered price may be lower than the open-market price. Compare the skin selling and instant-sell sections.

items.summary: I Want to Trade One Item for Another
items.body: Trading services are designed to work with a user inventory and the platform's own stock or offers from other users. Before making a trade, consider not only the interface but also the difference between the value of the item you give and the item you receive, the available inventory and possible fees. These platforms are listed in the CS2 skin trading section.

items.summary: I Am Interested in Cases, Roulette, Crash or Other Game Modes
items.body: For gaming platforms, it is usually better to use the ranking for the exact mode you want. A site with a strong case-opening section will not necessarily be equally suitable for match betting or roulette. CSGOBROKER separates these platforms into categories such as case opening, roulette, crash, case battles and upgrader.

items.summary: I Want to Earn Rewards Without Buying Skins
items.body: Some services offer rewards for completing tasks, using offerwalls or being active in games. The reward format varies: internal coins, gift cards, cryptocurrency or in-game items may be available. Check the minimum withdrawal amount and payout methods in advance. See the task sites and play-to-earn sections.

methodology.title: How CSGOBROKER Builds Site Rankings
methodology.intro: A platform should not be judged by a single metric. A large bonus does not compensate for inconvenient withdrawals, and a wide item selection matters less when transaction terms are unclear. We therefore consider several groups of factors and update information when site conditions, functionality or availability change.

items.summary: Reputation and Operational Stability
items.body: We consider how long a platform has been operating, the stability of its main functions, significant changes to the service and the overall predictability of the user experience. For an established site, popularity alone is not enough; it also matters whether the service continues to work reliably after updates.

items.summary: Deposits, Withdrawals and Fees
items.body: We compare available deposit and withdrawal methods, support for skins, traditional payment methods or cryptocurrency, minimum and maximum amounts, fees and restrictions. For trading services, the difference between the displayed item value and the amount the user actually receives after the transaction also matters.

items.summary: Inventory, Game Modes and Functionality
items.body: The criterion depends on the page type. A marketplace is evaluated by its inventory and search tools, a trading site by the availability of items to exchange, a gambling platform by its game modes, and a task site by the range of ways users can earn rewards.

items.summary: Bonuses and Their Conditions
items.body: We do not look only at the headline bonus amount. Activation method, validity period, restrictions, deposit or wagering requirements and the ability to withdraw the reward are also important. Current offers are collected in the bonuses section.

items.summary: Ease of Use
items.body: We consider interface clarity, the operation of key functions on desktop and mobile devices, the speed of common actions, the availability of clear rules and access to support. These factors become especially important when two services offer similar prices or terms.

items.summary: Transparency and Verifiability of Terms
items.body: We look at how easy it is to find the service rules, bonus terms, fees, verification requirements and information about individual functions. For game modes, an additional factor may be the availability of result-verification mechanisms where the platform provides them.

updates.title: Why Data and Rankings Change
paragraphs: Third-party services regularly change fees, bonuses, payment methods, supported countries, inventory, game modes and withdrawal rules. For this reason, a CSGOBROKER ranking is not a permanent list: a site can move after its terms or functionality change. The same applies to promo codes and bonuses — an offer that was attractive before may become less useful after activation or withdrawal requirements are updated.

When choosing a platform, we recommend looking not only at its position in the ranking but also at the information in its card, the full review and the parameters that matter for your specific task. If you need a particular mode or a specific way to work with skins, use the specialized category where sites of the same type are compared.

safety.title: Safety When Using Third-Party Services
safety.intro: CSGOBROKER is an informational website and does not replace checking the terms of a specific platform before using it. Availability and applicable rules may depend on the user's country. When working with skins, Steam and payments, always verify the site address and read the transaction terms before confirming an action.

items.summary: Check the Domain Before Signing in Through Steam
items.body: Phishing copies can visually imitate well-known platforms. Before signing in, verify the page address and avoid Steam authorization pages reached through suspicious domains, random ads or unsolicited messages.

items.summary: Check Every Steam Trade Offer
items.body: Before confirming a trade, compare the sender and every item in the offer. A bot name, avatar or similar display name alone does not prove that the offer was sent by the intended service.

items.summary: Read Withdrawal and KYC Rules in Advance
items.body: Some services introduce verification requirements or withdrawal restrictions at certain amounts or for particular payment methods. It is better to check these rules before depositing funds or transferring valuable items.

items.summary: Do Not Judge an Offer Only by the Bonus
items.body: A large percentage or free reward may come with additional requirements. Before activating it, check the minimum deposit, wagering conditions, validity period and restrictions on withdrawing bonus funds or items.
